_comment: One hand-written name per weapon x background pair (GAME_DESIGN §3.2). This replaces the old prefix+noun generator, which produced 90 rows that read as only 10 families — every Gutter Rat was Gutter-something. A generated name tells the player which bucket they picked; a written one tells them who they are. Keyed weapon:background. All 90 exist, including the pairs currently forbidden, so lifting a prohibition never leaves a hole.

longsword:gravedigger.title: Sexton
longsword:gravedigger.gloss: Keeper of the ground and everything set into it.

longsword:caravan_guard.title: Doorward
longsword:caravan_guard.gloss: You held one. It is the whole of your career.

longsword:scholar.title: Spellblade
longsword:scholar.gloss: Fencing was the only faculty that would still have you. You made it arcane before they could throw you out.

longsword:gutter_rat.title: Bravo
longsword:gutter_rat.gloss: A sword for hire, and the hire was never much.

longsword:ferryman.title: Tidesworn
longsword:ferryman.gloss: You swore it on moving water, which does not hold oaths well.

longsword:debt_collector.title: Enforcer
longsword:debt_collector.gloss: The blade was rarely necessary. That was rather the point of it.

longsword:mine_child.title: Pitguard
longsword:mine_child.gloss: Somebody has to stand at the top of the shaft.

longsword:apostate.title: Recreant
longsword:apostate.gloss: A knight who yielded, and said why, and was not forgiven for the saying.

longsword:fenwitch.title: Marshwarden
longsword:fenwitch.gloss: The fen has borders. You are what stands on them.

longsword:deserter.title: Oathbreaker
longsword:deserter.gloss: You have stopped arguing with the word.

warhammer:gravedigger.title: Barrowbreaker
warhammer:gravedigger.gloss: Some of them have to be opened. You are who they send.

warhammer:caravan_guard.title: Bulwark
warhammer:caravan_guard.gloss: Not a fighter. A wall that eats.

warhammer:scholar.title: Iconoclast
warhammer:scholar.gloss: You broke the images, and you could cite why.

warhammer:gutter_rat.title: Bruiser
warhammer:gutter_rat.gloss: No technique whatsoever and a perfect record.

warhammer:ferryman.title: Anchorhand
warhammer:ferryman.gloss: You have swung heavier than this off a moving deck.

warhammer:debt_collector.title: Legbreaker
warhammer:debt_collector.gloss: The oldest instrument of credit in the city.

warhammer:mine_child.title: Hewer
warhammer:mine_child.gloss: A trade name, not a fighting one. It transferred.

warhammer:apostate.title: Templebreaker
warhammer:apostate.gloss: You did not leave quietly and you did not leave it standing.

warhammer:fenwitch.title: Cairnsmith
warhammer:fenwitch.gloss: You built the stones that keep things in. You know where they are weak.

warhammer:deserter.title: Mutineer
warhammer:deserter.gloss: You did not run first. You just ran loudest.

spear:gravedigger.title: Pallguard
spear:gravedigger.gloss: You walk beside the box and you carry something with a point on it.

spear:caravan_guard.title: Outrider
spear:caravan_guard.gloss: Two miles ahead of the wagons, alone, for six seasons.

spear:scholar.title: Runelancer
spear:scholar.gloss: You read how it was done, carved the formula down the shaft, and then went and did it.

spear:gutter_rat.title: Gaffer
spear:gutter_rat.gloss: A boat hook, filed. It reaches further than anyone expects.

spear:ferryman.title: Poleman
spear:ferryman.gloss: Twenty years pushing off the bottom. The reach is instinct.

spear:debt_collector.title: Distrainer
spear:debt_collector.gloss: Licensed to seize goods, and to keep a distance while seizing them.

spear:mine_child.title: Timberman
spear:mine_child.gloss: You set the props that stop the roof. You know what holds.

spear:apostate.title: Reaver
spear:apostate.gloss: There is no order left to be a spear for. There is still the spear.

spear:fenwitch.title: Rushcutter
spear:fenwitch.gloss: Waist-deep work, done with a long blade on a long handle.

spear:deserter.title: Skirmisher
spear:deserter.gloss: Never in the line. Always on the edge of it, already facing back.

longbow:gravedigger.title: Yewman
longbow:gravedigger.gloss: The churchyard grows the wood. You always knew what it was for.

longbow:caravan_guard.title: Sentinel
longbow:caravan_guard.gloss: High on the load, watching the treeline, for years.

longbow:scholar.title: Ballistician
longbow:scholar.gloss: You can derive the arc. It has never once helped you loose faster.

longbow:gutter_rat.title: Roofrunner
longbow:gutter_rat.gloss: Nobody looks up. You built a career on nobody looking up.

longbow:ferryman.title: Farbank
longbow:ferryman.gloss: You have been judging that distance your entire life.

longbow:debt_collector.title: Reckoner
longbow:debt_collector.gloss: The account is settled at whatever range you decide it is.

longbow:mine_child.title: Darkshot
longbow:mine_child.gloss: You do not need to see it. You need to hear it once.

longbow:apostate.title: Excommunicate
longbow:apostate.gloss: Cast out, and left with the one skill they did not think to take.

longbow:fenwitch.title: Fowler
longbow:fenwitch.gloss: Marsh birds, at dusk, on the wing. Everything else is easier.

longbow:deserter.title: Longshot
longbow:deserter.gloss: You have only ever shot at things that were coming for you.

daggers:gravedigger.title: Shroudcutter
daggers:gravedigger.gloss: Someone opens the cloth. It has always been you.

daggers:caravan_guard.title: Bodyguard
daggers:caravan_guard.gloss: Close work, in a crowd, without anybody noticing it happened.

daggers:scholar.title: Hexknife
daggers:scholar.gloss: You wanted to know how it worked while it still did. The answer fit neatly along a blade.

daggers:gutter_rat.title: Shiv
daggers:gutter_rat.gloss: Not what you carry. What they call you.

daggers:ferryman.title: Linecutter
daggers:ferryman.gloss: One stroke, and whatever was tied to you is not.

daggers:debt_collector.title: Clipper
daggers:debt_collector.gloss: You took a little off the edge of everything that passed through.

daggers:mine_child.title: Narrowman
daggers:mine_child.gloss: You fit where nobody grown can, and you arrive with both hands full.

daggers:apostate.title: Defiler
daggers:apostate.gloss: You were told what the word meant. You went and earned it.

daggers:fenwitch.title: Thornhand
daggers:fenwitch.gloss: Everything in the hedge is sharp. You are only the newest part of it.

daggers:deserter.title: Turncoat
daggers:deserter.gloss: The knife you kept was the officer's. Nobody has ever asked.

staff:gravedigger.title: Wakekeeper
staff:gravedigger.gloss: You sat up with them. Something sat up with you.

staff:caravan_guard.title: Warder
staff:caravan_guard.gloss: You learned it to keep the wagons whole, which it did, mostly.

staff:scholar.title: Magus
staff:scholar.gloss: The title they stripped from you. You have kept using it.

staff:gutter_rat.title: Trickster
staff:gutter_rat.gloss: Half of it is real. You have stopped keeping track of which half.

staff:ferryman.title: Riverwright
staff:ferryman.gloss: You did not learn this. The crossing taught you, slowly, without asking.

staff:debt_collector.title: Bindsman
staff:debt_collector.gloss: Binding is binding, whether it is written or spoken.

staff:mine_child.title: Delver
staff:mine_child.gloss: Down is a direction you have never been frightened of.

staff:apostate.title: Heresiarch
staff:apostate.gloss: You did not merely leave. You took people with you.

staff:fenwitch.title: Hedgewitch
staff:fenwitch.gloss: Passed across a table, never written down, never once failed you.

staff:deserter.title: Vagrant
staff:deserter.gloss: The walking did not stop, and somewhere in it you picked this up.

tome:gravedigger.title: Obituarist
tome:gravedigger.gloss: You wrote the register. You noticed which names came back.

tome:caravan_guard.title: Chronicler
tome:caravan_guard.gloss: Somebody kept the road log. It turned out to matter.

tome:scholar.title: Archivist
tome:scholar.gloss: You were right, in writing, in front of the wrong people.

tome:gutter_rat.title: Forger
tome:gutter_rat.gloss: You cannot read half of it. You can copy all of it.

tome:ferryman.title: Logkeeper
tome:ferryman.gloss: Every fare, every crossing, every one that did not come back.

tome:debt_collector.title: Ledgerbound
tome:debt_collector.gloss: The book stopped being a record somewhere around the fourth column.

tome:mine_child.title: Seamreader
tome:mine_child.gloss: You read rock before you read letters and you read it better.

tome:apostate.title: Apocryphon
tome:apostate.gloss: The text they would not canonise. You have it by heart.

tome:fenwitch.title: Charmwright
tome:fenwitch.gloss: Written down at last, against every instruction you were given.

tome:deserter.title: Redactor
tome:deserter.gloss: You have been striking your own name out of things for years.

lantern:gravedigger.title: Lychbearer
lantern:gravedigger.gloss: The gate, the light, the long walk in. All of it yours.

lantern:caravan_guard.title: Nightwatch
lantern:caravan_guard.gloss: Third bell to ninth, every night, for eleven years.

lantern:scholar.title: Lumen Knight
lantern:scholar.gloss: You lit manuscripts before you lit anything else. Now the light answers when you lift a weapon with it.

lantern:gutter_rat.title: Snuffer
lantern:gutter_rat.gloss: You learned the light so you would know exactly when to kill it.

lantern:ferryman.title: Beaconman
lantern:ferryman.gloss: You were the thing on the bank that told people where the bank was.

lantern:debt_collector.title: Herald
lantern:debt_collector.gloss: You arrive lit, and announced, and that is most of the work done.

lantern:mine_child.title: Lampwright
lantern:mine_child.gloss: Gauze, oil, and a flame that must never touch the air down there.

lantern:apostate.title: Vigil
lantern:apostate.gloss: You kept it after you stopped believing in what it was kept for.

lantern:fenwitch.title: Wisp
lantern:fenwitch.gloss: You spent your girlhood following them. Now something follows you.

lantern:deserter.title: Watchbreaker
lantern:deserter.gloss: You put the lamp down at your post and walked. It is still lit.

censer:gravedigger.title: Thurifer
censer:gravedigger.gloss: You swung it at every graveside in the parish. It swings the same.

censer:caravan_guard.title: Smokeward
censer:caravan_guard.gloss: Keeps the flies off the meat and other things off the wagons.

censer:scholar.title: Runethurifer
censer:scholar.gloss: You studied the rite. You never expected the smoke to carry formulae, or for them to work.

censer:gutter_rat.title: Ashthief
censer:gutter_rat.gloss: You stole it from a chapel and it has not stopped burning since.

censer:ferryman.title: Mistbringer
censer:ferryman.gloss: The river does this on its own. You have learned to ask it to.

censer:debt_collector.title: Absolver
censer:debt_collector.gloss: You are the only man in the city who can clear a debt permanently.

censer:mine_child.title: Blackdamp
censer:mine_child.gloss: Named for the gas that kills quietly. You were named for it young.

censer:apostate.title: Defrocked
censer:apostate.gloss: They took the vestments. Nobody thought to take this.

censer:fenwitch.title: Miasmist
censer:fenwitch.gloss: The fen breathes out. You have simply learned to aim it.

censer:deserter.title: Penitent
censer:deserter.gloss: You carry it because putting it down once was enough.

gravebell:gravedigger.title: Knell
gravebell:gravedigger.gloss: You rang them down for twelve years. Ringing one back up is the same motion performed with a different intention.

gravebell:caravan_guard.title: Tollman
gravebell:caravan_guard.gloss: Every road has a toll and you spent six seasons collecting it in the only currency that matters. Now you are collecting arrears.

gravebell:scholar.title: Necrologist
gravebell:scholar.gloss: The monograph was going to be called On the Persistence of the Animate. The committee never read past the title and, in fairness, neither did you.

gravebell:gutter_rat.title: Bodysnatcher
gravebell:gutter_rat.gloss: Nobody taught you that a corpse is just unattended property. You worked it out on your own, the way you worked out everything.

gravebell:ferryman.title: Drowner
gravebell:ferryman.gloss: You took them across for twenty years and never once asked what was owed on the far side. Now you are asking, and they are answering.

gravebell:debt_collector.title: Repossessor
gravebell:debt_collector.gloss: Death does not discharge a debt. It only moves the conversation somewhere less convenient, and you have never minded the walk.

gravebell:mine_child.title: Deadfall
gravebell:mine_child.gloss: The gallery took forty men in one afternoon and the company wrote it off in an hour. You have been ringing for them ever since.

gravebell:apostate.title: Anathema
gravebell:apostate.gloss: They read you out of the order by name, in front of witnesses, with the bell. You kept the bell.

gravebell:fenwitch.title: Bonewife
gravebell:fenwitch.gloss: Hedge-work does not stop at the churchyard wall. It never did. That is the part they always found objectionable.

gravebell:deserter.title: Revenant
gravebell:deserter.gloss: You walked away from the standard and the standard has been walking after you ever since, and it has brought the whole company with it.
